items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1964-03-21
items.q: I used to listen, I used to listen at, see, Ori, Ori, Ori band originated out there in the country... they used to come out there and play

ctx.x: I don't mean to cut you off, but when you were a kid like that, was there anybody you listened to that was your favorite, that you might copy out of?

Well, I used to listen, I used to listen at, see, Ori, Ori, Ori band originated out there in the country, in the Platt. Mm-hmm. After they came, they came down here and lived down here, well, they used to come out there and play, you know. Mm-hmm. Ori. And, uh.
